system.description:
FOCUS MORROWMADE

Pain teaches your flesh. Once exposed to a form of harm, your body begins restructuring itself to ensure the same mistake is not repeated.
Action R; Trigger You suffer acid, cold, electricity, fire or poison damage.
After resolving the triggering damage, your body adapts to it.
You gain Resistance to the triggering damage type until the end of your next turn.
The adaptation may produce visible changes appropriate to the damage: heat-blackened scales, translucent insulating tissue, conductive metallic veins, hardened scar plates or other unsettling alterations.

Prerequisites Level 10

Use as the Reaction (Focus): choose the damage type just suffered; Resistance to it lands on your defences until the end of your next turn.
